# TASK: Home page

## GOAL
Give visitors a quick first impression of the studio and point them to the musicians, festival and contact tabs.

## DATABASE
None. Reads /content/studio.ts, /content/musicians.ts (featured), /content/festival.ts, /content/about.ts (first section).

## UI
Components required:
- Hero — studio name, tagline, background photo, "Get in touch" button (mailto)
- FeaturedMusicians — strip of MusicianCard for musicians where featured = true
- FestivalTeaser — festival name, dates, "Free entry", Countdown, link to /festival
- AboutTeaser — first about section excerpt + link to /background

Pages affected:
- /app/page.tsx

## VALIDATION (Zod)
Not needed (static content).

## BACKEND
Uses getStudio(), listMusicians({ featured: true }), getFestival(), isFestivalUpcoming(), listAboutSections().

## BEHAVIOR
1. Visitor lands on /
2. Sees hero, featured musicians, festival teaser with countdown, about excerpt
3. Clicks through to the relevant tab

## API ACTIONS
None.

## DONE WHEN
- [x] All four sections render from /content data
- [x] Festival teaser hides the countdown once the festival has started, and the whole teaser once it has ended
- [x] Featured strip shows an empty state if no musician is featured
- [x] Layout works at all four breakpoints
